importance_detail.rationale: This appropriations bill provides hundreds of billions of dollars in federal funding for the Departments of Labor, Health and Human Services, and Education, and related agencies for fiscal year 2027. It directly impacts millions of students, patients, workers, beneficiaries of federal programs, and state and local governmental bodies through sweeping funding allocations, program restrictions, and statutory changes.

label: H.R. 9260

latest_action.text: Placed on the Union Calendar, Calendar No. 604.

selection.reason: Impact scored and summarised by Gemini.

summary: H.R. 9260 provides fiscal year 2027 appropriations and sets policy requirements for the Departments of Labor, Health and Human Services, and Education, as well as various related agencies.

affected_groups.effect: Receives funding and operates under specific administrative, spending, and reporting requirements for fiscal year 2027.

Subject to changes in federal student loan availability, Pell Grant maximum funding levels of $6,385 for award year 2027-2028, and prohibitions regarding athletic participation and curricula restrictions.
Impacted by funding and regulations concerning workplace safety enforcement, wage standards, and training programs administered by the Department of Labor.

key_provisions: Provides annual appropriations for the Department of Labor, including the Employment and Training Administration, OSHA, the Mine Safety and Health Administration, and the Bureau of Labor Statistics.
Provides annual appropriations for the Department of Health and Human Services, including funding for the CDC, NIH, SAMHSA, and the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services.

Provides annual appropriations for the Department of Education, including funding for elementary and secondary education, special education, student financial assistance, and the Institute of Education Sciences.
Provides annual appropriations for related agencies such as the Social Security Administration, the Corporation for National and Community Service, and the National Labor Relations Board.
Establishes restrictions prohibiting the use of funds for abortion services, certain needle exchange programs, diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives, and specific OSHA and health standards.

Modifies federal student loan provisions by terminating the authority to make subsidized Federal Direct Stafford loans to undergraduate students for periods of instruction beginning on or after July 1, 2027.
summary_detail.plain_summary: H.R. 9260 provides fiscal year 2027 appropriations and sets policy requirements for the Departments of Labor, Health and Human Services, and Education, as well as various related agencies.
summary_detail.significance: The bill establishes federal spending and policy directives across major civilian departments, affecting nationwide education, health, labor, and social security programs.
